t: Introduction and overview — Ford Bronco First Generation (1966-1977)
name: Introduction and overview — Ford Bronco First Generation (1966-1977) — car record
title: Introduction and overview — Ford Bronco First Generation (1966-1977)
description: Introduction and overview of the Ford Bronco First Generation (1966-1977): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The first-generation Ford Bronco (1966-77) was Ford's compact 4x4 answer to the Jeep: simple, boxy, and nearly indestructible, in wagon, half-cab, and roadster forms. With 170/289/302 engines it became a Baja and off-road legend. Early Broncos are now among the hottest collector 4x4s. Baseline facts: American 4x4 1966-1977; first-gen Bronco; Baja and off-road legend..
